articles.headline: Saudi Arabia insists Asian Cup remains on track despite Houthi attacks
articles.description: Saudi Arabia has insisted that preparations for next January's Asian Cup remain on schedule despite ongoing attacks by Yemeni-based Houthi rebels.

images.name: Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa [1296x729]
images.caption: Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa is President of the Asian Football Confederation (AFC).
images.credit: Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty Images

articles.headline: Saudi attacks raise fresh concerns over Asian Cup
articles.description: Football Australia is closely monitoring the fall-out from air strikes on Riyadh's international airport as doubts grow over whether next January's Asian Cup will still take place in Saudi Arabia.

articles.headline: Lion City Sailors resume Mark Jackson era looking to go all the way in ASEAN Club Championship
articles.description: Mark Jackson will finally take charge of his second game at Lion City Sailors -- three weeks after his first.

images.name: Mark Jackson [1296x729]
images.caption: Due to the timing -- and increase in length -- of the international window, Mark Jackson has had to wait three weeks for his second game in charge of Lion City Sailors.

images.name: Lion City Sailors vs. BG Pathum United [1296x729]
images.caption: Mark Jackson's first game in charge of Lion City Sailors last month saw his new side take the lead against BG Pathum United before ultimately having to settle for a 1-1 draw in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Lion City Sailors vs. BG Pathum United: Hugo Gomes [1296x729]
images.caption: Lion City Sailors' new Brazilian defender Hugo Gomes will be up against some familiar faces in Thursday's ASEAN Club Championship meeting with Công An Hà Nội -- having left the Vietnamese outfit in the offseason.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.

articles.headline: What Philippines learned from two ASEAN campaigns
articles.description: Philippines have shown enough promise over the past two tournaments. They now need to show progress.

images.name: Philippines [1296x729]
images.caption: Philippines failed to qualify for the final of the 2026 FIFA ASEAN Cup after finishing third in Group B -- although they ended their campaign with an impressive 2-1 win over Thailand.
images.credit: Pakawich Damrongkiattisak - FIFA/FIFA via Getty Images

articles.byline: Mikhail De Guzman and Pam Puri

articles.headline: AFC to introduce Nations League in shake-up of World Cup, Asian Cup qualification
articles.description: The Asian Football Confederation is set to introduce a Nations League competition, which will affect the qualification process for the World Cup and Asian Cup.

images.name: Australia vs. Japan [1296x729]
images.caption: The Asian Football Confederation is set to introduce a Nations League competition, which will significantly affect the qualification process for the FIFA World Cup and AFC Asian Cup.

articles.byline: Joey Lynch, Gabriel Tan, Stuart Randall

articles.headline: Garriock: Football Australia 'in favour' of AFC Nations League concept
articles.description: Football Australia has given an early thumbs-up to the AFC's proposed Nations League concept, with director Heather Garriock describing it as a 'great concept' to strengthen Asia's position in world football.

images.name: Garriock [1296x729]
images.caption: Heather Garriock spoke to ESPN about the AFC's proposed Nations League format.
images.credit: Asanka Ratnayake/Getty Images for Football Australia

images.name: Connor Metcalfe thunders home screamer vs. Brazil
images.caption: Alessandro Circati and Connor Metcalfe provide moments of brilliance in the Socceroos' 4-2 loss to Brazil.
